<img src="profilepic.jpg" alt="Yanhe Eddie Lu" style="float: right; width: 200px; margin-left: 20px; border-radius: 5px;">

I am a Finance PhD student at [Washington University Olin Business School](https://olin.washu.edu).

My main research interest is in corporate finance. I'm broadly interested in how frictions and incentives shape decision-making across agents. I work with both empirical causal inferences and theoretical modeling.

This website hosts my brief introduction of experiences in [`vitae`](cv.qmd) section. You can also explore my [`repositories`](repo/index.qmd).
